proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C H
  have e1 : A -ᵥ B = (A -ᵥ H) - (B -ᵥ H) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right A B H).symm
  have e2 : A -ᵥ C = (A -ᵥ H) - (C -ᵥ H) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right A C H).symm
  have e3 : C -ᵥ B = (C -ᵥ H) - (B -ᵥ H) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B H).symm
  rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V A B, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A C, dist_comm H B, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B H, dist_comm H C,
    dist_eq_norm_vsub V C H, e1, e2, e3, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, inner_sub_right]
  constructor <;> intro hh <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C H : P), inner ℝ (A -ᵥ H) (C -ᵥ B) = 0 ↔ dist A B ^ 2 - dist A C ^ 2 = dist H B ^ 2 - dist H C ^ 2
